name: Choo☆Kanojo ~Ano Ko wa Tsuri Goro, Tsurare Goro~
original_name: 釣☆カノジョ～あの娘は釣り頃、釣られ頃～
source: Born and raised in the city, Taichi isn't really that much of a city person at heart. Growing weary of his work, he decides to have a week vacation and take the opportunity to go traveling and indulge in river fishing.
translation: 太一在城市出生长大，内心却并不真正属于都市。日渐厌倦工作后，他决定休假一周，趁机外出旅行并享受溪流垂钓。
